They were coached by [[LaVall Jordan]], in his third year as head coach of his alma mater. The Bulldogs played their home games at [[Hinkle Fieldhouse]] in [[Indianapolis|Indianapolis, Indiana]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. The Bulldogs finished the season 23–9, 10–8 in [[2019–20 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] which put them in fifth place. As the No. 5 seed in the [[2020 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they were slated to play [[2019–20 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] in the second game of the quarterfinals, but the Tournament was cancelled at halftime of the first game due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], along with the rest of the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA postseason]]. ==Previous season == The [[2018–19 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 16–17, 7–11 in [[2018–19 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] which tied them for eighth place. As the No. 9 seed in the [[2019 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they were defeated by [[2018–19 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] in the quarterfinals. The Bulldogs received an at-large bid to the [[2019 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] as the No. 5 seed in the TCU bracket.
